title: Certify actual width-one GL2 target minima
body:
PR2599 leaves open whether a nonfaithful actual stream action can make a monomial target cheaper. This package settles exactly the GL2(F2), one-point-column, two-dirty-role case: all 36 ordered target pairs still require the sum of their direct coordinate-CNOT lengths. The result is a finite negative certificate for the actual full-stream operator model, where formal endpoint equality cannot be assumed.

Free scalar GL2 mixing is normalized using the two arbitrary payloads at the fixed zero address. This yields exactly twelve paid projector/address maps, with no residual free factor. The producer's complete graph contains 20,160 operators. A separate engine independently enumerates every active GL4 operator and embeds it in the full eight-column payload space; it checks all 241,920 transition inequalities, a descending neighbor at every nonidentity state, and all 288 columns of the 36 attaining endpoints. Consequently the distances are exact for all word lengths, rather than a bounded-radius exclusion.

The graph's layers at distances 0..8 are `1,12,80,454,2033,6558,8750,2170,102`. The target minimum histogram at costs 0..6 is `1,4,8,10,8,4,1`. PR2599's unchanged legal norm word still acts as identity in this actual graph, so no faithfulness premise has been silently restored.

Validation: native CPython 3.12.7 registered producer, independent complete-domain checker and all four export/semantic-control groups pass. Native CPython 3.14.5 passes both engines. Failure controls remove a state, falsify a distance, omit a paid call and duplicate a target; they fail the relevant mathematical checks before any digest comparison. Source drift, typed evidence and existing-output replacement are also rejected.

Independent AI review found no material issue. A third implementation generated the paid maps by enumerating all six scalar basis changes and conjugating single-role shears, then independently reproduced every one of the 20,160 distances and all 36 minima. The reviewer also checked normalization, the active-space embedding and the all-length certificate argument, and passed the registered replay.

```sh
python3.12 -I -O -B research/binary-gl2-width-one-minima/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/binary-gl2-width-one-minima/check.py
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/binary-gl2-width-one-minima
```

Scope: two arbitrary dirty streams, one point in F2² per address, the two coordinate-CNOT labels at unit price and optimistically free scalar GL2 mixing. Every paid inverse/restoration counts. There are no extra roles, clean inputs, resets, free address permutations or unfinished endpoint couplings. No third-role, width-zero, affine, changed-alphabet, physical compiler, supplier, reserve or exponent result is asserted. Widths at least two have separate credited faithful-action evidence; this new census concerns width one only.

Direct base: canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Source PR2599 is pinned at `cfafdd633cf4e2e534704ec3ddd684cb0c32734f`, with exact retained SHA256/Git blobs. Ross Richardson's retained symmetric-adjacent theorem supplies the formal S3 baseline; PR2544 is related tariff work. Prior 20,160-state scalar-XOR/block-shear packages use different alphabets and contracts. TASK.json records the picker refinement and bounded cache/live overlap coverage. Advance claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2599#issuecomment-6196266221.

Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No human or formal-kernel review is claimed. Open next questions concern a third restored dirty role and a written invariant for the actual nonfaithful representation.
